title: Ox Passion Berry Lemon Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Salts Berry Lemon delivers a bright and zesty fusion of mixed Berries and tangy Lemon. The sweet, juicy burst of ripe berries sets the stage, followed by a lively citrus twist that lifts the flavour with its refreshing tartness, creating a balanced blend of fruit and zest. Blended in a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, ensuring a smooth throat hit and well-defined flavour. Perfect for pod vape kits and starter devices, it delivers rapid nicotine absorption for a consistently satisfying vape experience. Developed by Oxva, a trusted name in vaping technology, the OX Passion Salts range features expertly crafted flavours designed to pair seamlessly with Oxva’s XLIM pod kits and other refillable vape devices.
